## Progress Update — WhatsApp Message Scheduler Bot Plan

- **Project Decomposition & Synthesis Completed**: The Project Orchestrator has synthesized the survey phase into the root `PROJECT.md`, formally specifying system architecture, 11 core feature items (F1–F11), and execution milestones.
- **Milestone 1 Deliverable Drafted**: Worker M1 has completed `docs/FEASIBILITY_AND_PLATFORM_ARCHITECTURE.md` (~1,110 lines, 71 KB), delivering an exhaustive technical feasibility analysis and comparative platform architecture.
- **Platform Trade-Offs Deeply Analyzed**: Detailed comparison between WhatsApp Cloud API (24-hour customer service window, pre-approved message templates, per-message utility costs) and personal multi-device client automation via Baileys (Noise XX handshake, pairing codes, multi-tenant session storage, anti-ban heuristics).
- **Quality Gates Queued**: Milestone 1 will now enter the verification track, including multi-reviewer evaluation, adversarial challenge rounds, and forensic auditing before Milestone 2 execution begins.
